title: Quiet Home, Private Patio & Easy City Access
description:
Experience authentic Nashville living with upgraded hospitality. Under new professional management, this light-filled 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home provides a relaxed sanctuary just minutes from the airport and downtown.

The space
Under new professional management, this light-filled 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home provides a relaxed sanctuary just minutes from the airport and downtown. Single-level home offers the perfect balance of peaceful neighborhood charm and swift access to Music City’s best attractions. Unwind after a day in the city on the private covered back patio, equipped with outdoor ceiling fans, comfortable wicker seating, and a Smart TV. Inside, you’ll find a bright layout featuring three cozy bedrooms and two full bathrooms, offering flexible sleeping arrangements for up to 8 guests.

Sleeping Arrangements
⊙ Bedroom 1: 1 Queen Bed + 1 Twin Futon
⊙ Bedroom 2: 1 Queen Bed
⊙ Bedroom 3: 1 Double Bed + 1 Twin Bed

Guest Access & Amenities
⊙ High-speed Wi-Fi & Smart TV
⊙ Fully equipped kitchen with essential appliances
⊙ In-unit washer & dryer
⊙ Central air conditioning & heating
⊙ Free driveway parking

Location Highlights
⊙ Nashville International Airport (BNA): ~5–6 min drive
⊙ Percy Priest & Old Hickory Lakes: ~4 min drive
⊙ Grand Ole Opry & Opry Mills: ~12 min drive
⊙ Downtown Nashville (Broadway): ~12 min drive

Guest access
The entire space is yours. Please make yourself at home. We utilize a digital lock with your own unique code that is emailed to you two days before check-in.

Other things to note
🧼 We clean with green, organic products to reduce environmental impact.
🚗 Extra parking is first-come, first-served in front of the building.
📞 If issues arise, we’ll act quickly, but there’s no 24/7 on-site staff.
